picture: Flat side view. Along a wooden sky-dock, the player in her lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands left of centre beside an awake chattering monkey. At the far left waits an empty glass-roofed trolley. In the centre rises an open spiral lift cage. At the far right hangs a waiting mountain cable tram.
